headline:
MCXCI-MCC: SPORADIC + SCHLÄFLI + K3 + UMBRAL MOONSHINE.

All 6 exact kissing dimensions {1,2,3,4,8,24} = substrate primitives;
All 6 K(d) values {2, 6, 12, 24, 240, 196560} = substrate primitives.
  Viazovska 2016: rho_8 = pi^4 / 384 = pi^4 / tau(O), rho_24 = pi^12/k!

Four Hopf fibrations: total dims = {1, q, Phi_6, g}; base = division alg.

Golay G_12 = [k, q!, q!]_3 (ternary); G_24 = [f, k, 2^q]_2 (binary)
  Only non-trivial perfect linear codes (Tietavainen-van Lint 1973)

26 sporadic finite simple groups = 2*Phi_3 = D_bosonic
  Split 20 + 6 = C(2q,q) + q! = Happy Family + Pariahs
  Five families: {5, 4, 3, 3, 11} = {mu+1, mu, q, q, k-1}

Mathieu degrees: {11, 12, 22, 23, 24} = {k-1, k, 2(k-1), 2k-1, k*lambda}
Co_1 order primes {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 23} ALL SRG polynomials

Schläfli double-six (Cayley 1849):
  27 lines = q^q = dim E_6 fundamental rep
  45 tritangent planes = q^2 + |Phi+(E_6)| = 9 + 36
  40 triads of double-sixes = v (deepest combinatorial identification!)
  |Aut(cubic)| = 51840 = |W(E_6)|

K3 invariants ALL substrate: chi = k*lambda = f; h^{1,1} = v/lambda = 20
  H^2(K3, Z) = qU + lambda*(-E_8) = q hyperbolic planes + lambda E_8 copies

Umbral moonshine = 23 = k*lambda - 1 = q^q - mu cases
  (Cheng-Duncan-Harvey 2014, one per non-Leech Niemeier lattice)

ROUND NUMBER MCC = 1200 = F(600-cell)
